overall: Atlanta is starting the day under thick overcast skies (OVC, 100% cloud fraction, ceiling ~200ft/61m) with temperatures flat at 71.6°F as of 6:40 AM — the running max has been stuck at 73.4°F since midnight with zero warming velocity. max_temp_prediction: If the overcast clears by late morning as the NWS expects, Atlanta can warm meaningfully into the mid-to-upper 80s, but the delayed start and high dewpoint will cap potential somewhat; the HRRR's 83.5°F floor and the META model's peak probability bucket at 84–85°F (26.5%) both point to a modest outcome relative to the NWS call.
